public_title: Mayors from around the world unite in call for sustainable urban data centres
discussion_statement: C40 describes a pact through which participating mayors seek to shape urban data-centre growth around energy, water, land, cost and community concerns.
summary: C40 describes a pact through which participating mayors seek to shape urban data-centre growth around energy, water, land, cost and community concerns.
